review_interpretation: All 112 IDs received manual role and scope/H review using their exact operative original fields. Hash checks are additional integrity checks, not scientific judgments.
Same AI and already exposed to own 97 codes and prior research material; not independent blind image rereading or external expert agreement.
Broad shared scene role does not require unique referent, complete inscription, resolved hand/glyph boundary, visible leader or historical common start.
Unresolved endpoint attribution alone is not an unresolved spatial field. Conversely an unobserved subregion cannot be filled from the clear center or surrounding rectangle.
Possible overrestriction flags on f72r2 ZO10/ZO11/ZO14 do not auto-upgrade NA: root should decide whether outward damage actually leaves a writing component outside recorded field scope.
f72r2 ZE04 flag concerns partial-window justification only; fixed-domain exclusion remains unchanged.
Source field weak contrast is not automatically uncertainty about spatial role; exact wording and stated extent were reviewed separately.
No other group new coding or root unfinalized reviews read; no new image, text matching, scores, web or Git work.
First report remains unchanged. This is not a vote or an adjudicated replacement; original sequence gate is unchanged.
